page.overview:
Who is Guss McCray?

Guss "Redbone" McCray is a Toreador antitribu and a member of The Dead Gypsies, a nomadic Sabbat pack. He acts as a mentor to many young members of the sect.

Born along the coast of Mississippi, Guss grew up as a sharecropper's son. He left home after getting a girl pregnant; marrying her was impossible because her father wanted to kill him. Relocating to New Orleans, Guss immersed himself in jazz and the blues. He became a talented singer and an excellent guitarist, but the trumpet truly captured his soul. His deep and soulful trumpet playing drew the attention of a Toreador antitribu, who listened to him perform for years.

When Guss abruptly quit playing, his vampiric admirer tracked him to a small apartment and discovered he was dying of leukemia. Believing Guss's art needed eternal life and knowing The Dead Gypsies needed recruits, the vampire offered him immortality. The sire took Guss to the nearest graveyard, Embraced him, and buried him. Guss clawed his way to the surface and immediately fought in a battle against Anarchs, proving himself as a True Sabbat. Since that night, he has been a valued member of his pack.

Equipment: Two Ruger Redhawks, silvered saber, trumpet
